shortDescription: Create or delete a private network for an SBM (Scalable Baremetal) server

options.name: distribution_method
options.description: Distribution method for the new network. Only C(gateway) is available.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of the SBM server (exact match on server title). Mutually exclusive with I(server_id).

options.name: mask
options.description: Subnet mask for the new network (/29 to /26). Required when I(state=present).

options.name: network_id
options.description: ID of the network to delete. Required when I(state=absent).

options.name: server_id
options.description: ID of the SBM server. Mutually exclusive with I(hostname).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates a new private IPv4 network. C(absent) deletes an existing network.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Polling interval (in seconds) while waiting. Every polling request reduces API rate limits.

options.name: wait
options.description: Time to wait (in seconds) for the network to reach desired state. For I(state)=C(present), waits for the network to become C(active) (CIDR is assigned once active). For I(state)=C(absent), waits for the network to be fully removed. Value C(0) disables waiting (fire-and-forget mode).
